snippet.title: Full Release Trailer | Paper Mario: Star Nova
snippet.description:
Download: Join the Discord server for more info!
https://discord.gg/RpvqnCXVhY


Thanks for all the support over the years - I appreciate it a lot! It is finally here!
Hope you enjoy your time in the kingdom of Stellaria! :)

Credits to dreaming_melo for the logo & title screen art (as well as other artwork seen in the mod itself)!
